main_text.p: contermina maximè desiccatoriam uim ha-bens colore pallida. Deinde mox subiun-git eos omnes,qui in hac magna peste(quę tum illic grassabatur in populum) de hoc Pharmaco biberunt, celerrimè fuisse sana-tos. Quibus uero nihil profuit, omnes in-terijse,nec ab alio quopiam opem sensisse. Bibitur(inquit)cum uino substantia tenui, mediocriter diluto, si febre penitùs careat homo,aut parum febricitet. Sin ualde fe-briat,cum aquato penitùs. Sed neque sunt adeò uehementer feruidæ pestilentes fe-Cap.36.bres.Paulus Æginetalibro 2.de Re medica boli Armenę uires aduersus pestiletes mor-bos,referens ipsa Galeni uerba in hūc mo-dum exprimit. Galenus(inquit)ad pesti-lentes putredines Armeniacam bolum,& similiter exuiperis theriacam magnopere prodesse ait. Profectò in peste, quæ Romæ grassata est,omnes mortui sunt, quib. neu-trum horum profuit.Post lib. septimo his addit eandem Armeniæ terram pestilenti-bus affectibus generose conuenire. Verùm quoniam hoc terræ genus, iusto Dei opti-mi & æquissimi iudicio,desideratur hodie, aut saltem per rarù est(quamuis aliàs Lug-duni habuerim) eius locum supplere po-test

page.notes: The printed s is long s throughout and has been written as plain s. The left-margin note "Cap.36." is printed in a larger, heavier face and partly overlaps the line "bres.Paulus". Faint show-through of text from the reverse side appears in the lower left and lower centre; it is not transcribed. Spelling kept as printed, including "Æginetalibro", "pestiletes" and "hūc".
